entries.title: Psalms 23:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of David.> The Lord takes care of me as his sheep; I will not be without any good thing.

entries.title: Psalms 23:2
segments: He makes a resting-place for me in the green fields: he is my guide by the quiet waters.

entries.title: Psalms 23:3
segments: He gives new life to my soul: he is my guide in the ways of righteousness because of his name.

entries.title: Psalms 23:4
segments: Yes, though I go through the valley of deep shade, I will have no fear of evil; for you are with me, your rod and your support are my comfort.

entries.title: Psalms 23:5
segments: You make ready a table for me in front of my haters: you put oil on my head; my cup is overflowing.

entries.title: Psalms 23:6
segments: Truly, blessing and mercy will be with me all the days of my life; and I will have a place in the house of the Lord all my days.
